Or run this in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mallen220/TurtleTracer/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` A .exe file is also provided below. ## Release Notes - Add event markers in the paths tab. Change robot defaults to be more realistic for most teams. Added "Previous" heading support, delete the start heading in a constant or linear path to check it out. Import Pedro constants into settings. Fix a bunch of old v2 simulation logic regarding the heading. Fixed optimizer over penalizing. Stop suggesting changing P when the robot can't change p. Possible fixed leaking paths that invalidated some session. Fix Linux window and app icons. Fixed bug on some OS's where toggle profiles led to stale states. Security Updates. The T value now appears in the field tab.

name: Turtle Tracer 2.4.0
body: ## Update v2.4.0 Refer to the README installation section for instructions on installing or updating Turtle Tracer. Below is a condensed version of the instructions for quick reference. This repo is regularly updated with new features and bug fixes but tested primarily on macOS. Should an issue arise, please report it via the GitHub Issues page and revert to the previous stable version if needed. #### **macOS / Linux** Run the following command in terminal. It asks which version you want (stable is the default; pre-releases are offered too) and shows what it will do before changing anything: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mallen220/TurtleTracer/main/install.sh | bash ``` To install exactly this version without being asked, add `-s -- --version 2.4.0` after `bash`. #### **Windows** Windows Users can download from the Microsoft Store to receive auto-updates for stable releases. Or run this in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mallen220/TurtleTracer/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` A .exe file is also provided below. Every download is listed in `SHA256SUMS`, which the installers use to verify what they fetch. ## Release Notes - New settings for motion profiling. "Stop to Turn" is now false by default. Accepts a Translational P for simulation. Users can use PP v3 or v2. Better explainations for updating motion settings. Allow users to setup complex braking rates. Added simulation for chained paths around corners. New warning type for sharp corners and high overshooting. Added new setting to optimizer to handle chained paths and overshoot calculations. Robot profiles carry more robot data. Forward and strafe velocity are labeled as such. Slow Down for Curves and Heading Response Time were removed because they changed the results very little. New interface setting to give everything square corners. Collision markers now line up with the robot's actual position. Angled robots are checked with the correct orientation, and thin obstacles crossing the robot are detected. Distance on curved paths is now measured along the curve instead of as straight segments. Large heading changes no longer rotate the long way around. Before its first path, the robot now faces the way that path starts. Transformed macros now move their heading targets with them. Facing-point and piecewise paths are tracked better in macros. Faster check against infinite macro recursion. "Save To" no longer marks the open project as saved. More stable project saving. Files opened through the system file picker are tracked correctly, including on Windows, where they could be written to the root of the drive. Renaming a file that is only selected no longer changes which project is open. The project-data preview in the export dialog shows exactly what saving will write, including unsaved changes. Updating a moved macro no longer rewrites other macro files with absolute paths. Robot profiles, plugin settings, and command palette history are kept between launches. Projects created by older versions no longer override the robot image you selected. Deleting control points in the waypoint table is more responsive. Shortcuts for reverse path, snap selection, and moving items up or down had stopped working. They work again. Adding a path, wait, or turn with the keyboard now matches the menu. The new item goes after your selection, and new paths start in a sensible position and direction. Clearing a start or end angle resets it to `0`, invalid values are no longer saved as `NaN`, and negative durations are rejected. Focusing a facing-point heading now moves straight to Target X. Dropping a marker onto an automatic turn on the timeline no longer deletes the turn. Pressing Escape in the playback time box now cancels your edit instead of committing it, and F2 "Rename" works on a path in the Paths tab. Java imports now read raw radians and common heading expressions such as `pose.getHeading()` and `turnTo(Math.toRadians(...))` correctly. SVG export includes the built-in robot when no robot image is set. GIF export no longer makes an extra PNG copy of every frame, so it does less work. Export tools load only when you use them, so the app loads about a quarter less script. The field panel no longer animates into place on startup, and the default field image is preloaded. Our desktop Lighthouse performance score went from about 78 to 96 in testing. Update information is fetched when you open Settings instead of on every launch, and timing is no longer recalculated several times for each edit. Plugin context-menu icons no longer break the field's right-click menu. For plugins, the `onSave` hook now runs for every save, however the user saves a project. It used to run only for saves from the file manager. Major code cleanup, increate in tests, and deduplication.

name: Pedro Pathing Visualizer 1.7.0
body:
## 🚀 Quick Update

Refer to the README installation section for instructions on installing or updating Pedro Pathing Visualizer. Below is a condensed version of the instructions for quick reference.

This repo is regularly updated with new features and bug fixes but tested primarily on macOS. Should an issue arise, please report it via the GitHub Issues page and revert to the previous stable version if needed.

#### **macOS / Linux**
Run the following command in terminal and provide your password when prompted:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mallen220/PedroPathingVisualizer/main/install.sh | bash
```

#### **Windows**
Download and install via the `.exe` installer below.

## 📝 Release Notes


- Added new Discord server link to Navbar! Join now and be one of the first members! Added Presentation Mode (Option/Alt + P). Added Plugin Manager. Add Git Status checker and diff view (Can be disabled in settings). Add Custom Field Map Import Wizard. Always more key binds, now supporting Copy, Cut, Paste. Add Keep-In Zones (opposite of Obstacles) and shape visibility controls. Add interactive onboarding tutorial to help new users. Command Palette now searches for paths, events, and waits in current file. Validation checks now work in ranges instead of points. Added continuous validation checker (disabled in settings by default). Add path analysis graphs to statistics dialog. Add Telemetry Data Import & Visualization (Will be expanded in future versions). Added file macros allowing users to pass auto sequences into other files (Drag and drop from file manager). Macros support path transformations and basic recursion. Added setting to change font size. Overhauled settings UI for cleaner interface.

Download the `.deb`, `.tar.gz`, or `.AppImage` file. Run in terminal with executable permissions.

## 📝 Release Notes

 (2026-01-12)

- Add Path Statistics dialog and integration. Add support for 'Rotate' sequence items that use PedroPathings turnto() method, including keybind, event marker, and sequential command support. Add Velocity Heatmap visualization in settings. Refactored event markers into global event markers for a better user experience and updated the obstacles UI to match, both are now in the control tab’s field tab. Reverse quality slider direction in ExportGifDialog. Add support for opening external links in default browser instead of Electron. Fix animation export cancellation support. Remove frame cap for GIF/APNG export and improve timing. Always new keybinds. Add "What's New" dialog for first launch and docs (Shift + N to open). Updated with support for PedroPathingPlus v1.0.6. Unify UI colors for event types: Path (Green), Wait (Amber), Rotate (Pink). Dramatically improve timeline visualizer with event markers, wait highlights, and rotate markers.

name: Pedro Pathing Visualizer 1.5.0
body:
## 🚀 Quick Update

> ### Important: An error causing Windows OS to recognize this program as a Trojan horse has been resolved. Please redownload this version for the fix. When users open the program they may still get a warning, they should press "More Info" then "Run Anyways" to start the program. Thank you for your patience as features are rapidly being added. If you find any errors please never hesitate to post them to the [Github Issues section](https://github.com/Mallen220/PedroPathingVisualizer/issues) where they will be resolved as quickly as possible.

## 📝 Release Notes

 (2026-01-07)

- Increase optimization mutation strength. Overhaul Navbar UI. Dramatically improved backend testing. Optimized field rendering logic. Overhaul key binds UI. Credits and Legal section added in settings. Add Animated PNG (APNG) export support. add duplicate key bind and functionality (shift+d). Add zoom controls, panning, and keyboard shortcuts to Field View. Improve export dialog. Resolve numerous TypeScript and Svelte check errors. Unified wait and path UI to be the same. open file manager on save for untitled projects. add reverse path tool. add field boundary validation and drag restrictions, configurable in settings. Added sticky header to waypoint table. Add name-based linking for waypoints and wait events with java exporter support. Add safety validation for zero-length paths. Added lots of tooltips.
